name: aai-programme
title: Assured AI programme

directories.description: This instance's work plan — one Markdown file per bean, managed with the `beans` CLI (`.beans.yml`).
directories._branch_comment: The beans already live on cat/aai-platform/beans, from before the repository was renamed. Rename the branch to cat/aai-programme/beans with the other renames (bean aai-platform-tren).

directories.description: The programme's processes as BPMN: who does each step of the build and where it must stop. Members of cat-harness's concern groups by sitting at the same-named path (`processes/process/`).
Source files as received, before ingestion: the programme requirements as the PM & Architecture Integration wrote them (v0.4.1 from litlfred/folio-assistant#2605) and the v0.4.2 draft.
The ingested requirements: one entry per version, its sections as JSON-LD nodes, so beans, processes and issues can cite a section.
Pages of this instance's site written in the repository, and the requirement nodes under docs/requirements/ (declared from within, docs/docs.json).

description: Coordination for the WHO Assured AI programme: the programme requirements, the processes that build and run it, and the combined work plan of the repositories it draws on. Staged in litlfred/aai-programme until the owner syncs it to the WHO organisation.
